title: Write a notes table migration with row level security
prompt: Write a Postgres migration file at supabase/migrations/ddl-only-migration.sql that creates a table named notes. The notes table needs an id uuid primary key, a shop_id uuid that is not null, a body text column that is not null, and a created_at timestamptz that is not null with a default of now(). Add an index on notes(shop_id). Enable row level security on notes and add exactly one policy that allows select to the authenticated role. Migrations contain DDL only; tests live in a tests folder. The table notes is also described in docs/table.md, which you may read. Do not create any other files.
